keyviewer.heading: KeyViewer Profiles
keyviewer.desc_1: A collection of modern minimal style KeyViewer profiles made for the KeyViewer mod.
keyviewer.basic_info_desc:
These profiles are either made for the KeyViewer mod versions 4.9.7 to 4.10.3, or the external program DM.NOTE. We recommend using DM.NOTE (Profiles configured using v 1.6.0) or older versions of KeyViewer (3.x.x, currently not supported because of their limited customizability) since newer versions of KeyViewer either have visual bugs or interfere with player inputs.

We recommend using the Chillax font, but you can also use other fonts if you prefer. The open-source Google Material Symbols font is required for DM.NOTE profiles to look properly, but you can customize them afterwards if you wish.
keyviewer.for_dmn_desc:
Profiles designed for use with the DM.NOTE external program, version v 1.6.0 is recommended.

How to Install

Extract the downloaded zip file, launch DM.NOTE and go to the profile settings. Click on the small triangle beside the folder icon located at the bottom right corner of the window, select Import, then Import to Current Tab. Select the desired profile, a .json file. For ususually long strings, you need to manually configure the font. Select the key, scroll down to the Font section and click Configure, click the + icon, Local Fonts, and Add (x). Import any varient of the Google Material Symbols font files, click Add (x), then OK and select that font. You can remap the keys and customize other settings as you like.
keyviewer.for_kv_mod_desc:
Profiles designed for use with the KeyViewer mod, requires version 4.9.7 to 4.10.3.

How to Install

Extract the downloaded zip file, launch ADOFAI and press Ctrl + F10 (by default) to open the Unity Mod Manager panel. Open the KeyViewer mod settings and click Import Profile, then select the desired profile, a .json file. Now you can adjust the offset to make it appear on screen, and remap keys if needed.

Please note that these profiles are incompatible with newer versions of KeyViewer (>4.10.3) due to recent changes in the mod's code. We recommend using DM.NOTE if needed.
